d:
Philippines go UNDEFEATED to win the Asia Cup!
The Philippines made HISTORY at the FIBA U16 Women's Asia Cup 2023 - Division B!
After an incredible run through the tournament, the Philippines faced Iran in the FINAL with the championship on the line. And they delivered a dominant performance!
Nevaeh Smith led the way with 21 points, while Ava Fajardo added 12 points and 9 assists to help the Philippines secure an impressive 83-60 victory!
With this win, the Philippines completed a PERFECT 5-0 run, claimed the Division B title and earned promotion to Division A for the next edition!
